name: affrescoui
description: Edit AffrescoUI screens: schemas, diagnostics from affrescoui check, a live preview, navigation, hovers and snippets.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In a workspace you haven't trusted, the extension runs no command: schemas, navigation, hovers and snippets still work, diagnostics and the preview don't.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Diagnostics and the preview need files on disk.

affrescoui.cliPath.markdownDescription: The `affrescoui` command-line tool: a name looked up in the absolute folders of `PATH` (never the screen's own folder), or an absolute path. The extension runs only `affrescoui check --json` and `affrescoui render`.

affrescoui.check.enabled.markdownDescription: Report the problems `affrescoui check --json` finds when a screen is opened or saved.

affrescoui.check.timeoutMs.markdownDescription: How long `affrescoui check` may run before it is stopped, in milliseconds.

affrescoui.preview.scale.markdownDescription: The preview's `--scale`: 2 draws at twice the window's size.

affrescoui.preview.size.markdownDescription: The preview's `--size WIDTHxHEIGHT`, or empty for the screen's own window size.

affrescoui.preview.timeoutMs.markdownDescription: How long `affrescoui render` may run before it is stopped, in milliseconds.

affrescoui.preview.maxPixels.markdownDescription: The largest preview shown, in pixels a side; a larger render isn't drawn.

scripts.test: npm run compile && node --test out/test/resolver.test.js out/test/check.test.js out/test/tool.test.js
